newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices post sharp gains.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices post sharp gains.

text.p: Arabica prices in the Bremen coffee market jumped $13-28 on the week per 50 kg fob after gains of $11-13 last week as futures rallies continued.
Traders successfully placed some competitive second hand Feb/April material as origin prices ran out of control despite origin attempts to reduce differentials over futures.
African arabicas prices rose even more strongly than Brazils and Central Americans.
Robusta prices showed more modest gains.
German coffee roasters said they may add to recent retail price hike announcements in order to pass on higher costs.
